videos.title: Qwik Crash Course (first look) #1 - Hydration vs Resumability
videos.description: This video explains Qwik's underlying mechanics, particularly its resumability feature, contrasting it with traditional hydration. It also covers the initial steps of building a basic application using the Qwik framework.

videos.title: Qwik Crash Course (first look) #2 - Creating a New Qwik App
videos.description: This video demonstrates creating a new Qwik application, covering the initial setup process. It explores the framework's core functionalities for new projects.

videos.title: Get Started With Qwik: The JavaScript Framework Game-Changer
videos.description: This video introduces the Qwik JavaScript framework, explaining core concepts such as resumability, lazy loading, and JavaScript streaming. It demonstrates developing a Qwik web application, covering routing, components, state management, and route loaders.

videos.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Qwik Start || #qwiklabs || #GSP100 ||  [With Explanation🗣️]
videos.description: This video provides a quick start guide to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), demonstrating the setup and basic use of GKE by running specific shell commands to deploy and manage containerized applications. It covers essential steps within a Google Cloud environment.
